subject: Validation sprint plan and kickoff cadence for DataGrid evaluation
messages:
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan@redwood.ai>
To: Erin Park <erin@datagrid.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-22T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Recap + proposed validation sprint (success criteria, owners, cadence)

Hi Erin — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and a proposed plan so we can lock dates and owners. Please confirm/edit below.

Call highlights
- Goal: Validate low-latency extraction and retrieval pipeline with ~50k tokens/day for the first month, and measure 99th percentile generation latency under 350ms for common paths.
- Primary success criteria (what DataGrid needs to see to sign off):
  * Latency: 99th percentile per-token generation <= 350ms for templated prompts (50k token/day sample)
  * Quality: BLEU-like/acceptance pass-rate >= 85% on your annotation set for the three primary intents
  * Cost per query: baseline estimate and 20% improvement scenarios from batching/quantization
  * Observability: end-to-end tracing and KV cache hit metrics available in the dashboard

Proposed evaluation plan (2-week sprint cadence + final readout):
1) Kickoff week (week 0): data handoff, access, test dataset format check, SOW/roles locked
2) Sprint 1 (week 1): baseline runs, config for batching and cache; collect metrics
3) Sprint 2 (week 2): tuning and regression checks; validate quality on held-out set
4) Readout (end of week 2): results dashboard, cost/latency breakdown, decision/recommendation

Proposed owners at Redwood
- SE & onboarding lead: Sergio Alvarez (will handle model variant setup, kernel selection, and runbook)
- Customer success (weekly check-ins & readout): Grace Oconnor
- Deal owner / escalation: Marissa Cole

Proposed cadence
- Kickoff (30–60m): Sept 1–3 window — prefer Sept 1 or 2
- Weekly checkpoints: Tuesdays 9:00 AM PT (15–30m) during the sprint or ad-hoc as needed
- Final readout: end of Sprint 2 (30–45m)

Immediate asks for DataGrid
- Confirm the three success criteria above or add/modify
- Share the sample logs/dataset (redacted) and a contact for procurement for SOW
- Confirm your preferred kickoff date (Sept 1–3 or suggest alternate)

Attachments: redwood-poc-playbook.pdf (playbook with templates), draft SOW template (we can fill with your contract terms once procurement chimes in)

Thanks — I can update the doc and send the invite as soon as you confirm.

—
Rohan Mehta
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rohan@redwood.ai

Thanks Rohan — this is helpful. A few clarifications from our side:

- Overall timeline: our eng team is heads-down until Sept 4, so kickoff on Sept 1–2 is tight for us. Can we aim for the week of Sept 7 (preferably Sept 7 or 8)?
- Success criteria tweaks:
  * Latency: 99th percentile <= 375ms for our templated prompts (we'll provide the exact prompt set)
  * Quality: acceptance pass-rate >= 80% on the labeled subset (we can supply the labels)
  * Observability: must include request ID correlation with our internal tracing (we'll provide sample spans)
- Procurement asked that any SOW include a 30-day termination clause and an estimated monthly token cap — we can send a sample PO once those are in place.

I attached a tiny sample of our logs (datagrid-sample-logs.csv) so your SE can sanity-check the format. Samir will lead the technical side from DataGrid — looping him in.

If you can push the kickoff to Sept 7, that works better. Please loop in your CS and SE and share a draft SOW and a Drive link for shared artifacts.

Thanks,
Erin
Erin Park
